name: inspect
description: Connect (read-only) and describe a database's schema, tables and sizes.
body: Inspect the database referenced in $ARGUMENTS using the `database-tools` skills. Detect the client (psql/mysql/sqlite3/mongosh) first. Run read-only introspection to list schemas/tables, row counts and sizes, and key indexes. Never print credentials/connection strings in full; redact secrets.

name: query
description: Run a read-only query and format the results (writes require confirmation).
body: Run the query in $ARGUMENTS using the `sql`/database skills. For SELECTs, run and format results. If the statement writes or is destructive (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP/TRUNCATE), show it and require explicit confirmation before executing, and refuse UPDATE/DELETE without a WHERE unless the user insists knowingly.

name: schema
description: Show and explain the schema of a table or the whole database.
body: Show the schema for $ARGUMENTS (a table, or the whole DB). Detect the client, run the appropriate describe/DDL command, and explain columns, types, keys, indexes and relationships. Note anything risky (missing indexes, no FKs, overly wide columns).

name: optimize
description: Diagnose a slow query using its execution plan and suggest fixes.
body: Optimize the query in $ARGUMENTS using the `db-query-optimization` skill. Run EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE, read the plan, and identify the dominant cost. Suggest concrete fixes (indexes, rewrites) and, if applied, show before/after timings. Do not add indexes blindly.

name: migrate
description: Plan or review a schema migration for safety and reversibility.
body: Review or plan the migration in $ARGUMENTS using the `db-migrations` skill. Check it is reversible/backward-compatible (expand-contract), and that large-table changes won't cause long locks. Flag destructive steps and require a backup + confirmation before running anything destructive.

name: backup
description: Back up a database safely and verify the dump.
body: Back up the database in $ARGUMENTS using the `db-backup-restore` skill. Use the correct dump tool (pg_dump/mysqldump/etc.), write to a safe location, and verify the dump is non-empty/valid. Redact credentials in any output. Remind the user a backup is only real once a restore has been tested.

name: explain
description: Explain what a SQL query does and its performance characteristics.
body: Explain the SQL in $ARGUMENTS in plain language: what it returns, the joins/filters, and likely performance characteristics (scans, sorts, cardinality). Point out correctness risks (cartesian joins, NULL logic, missing WHERE).

name: seed
description: Generate or run seed/fixture data for a schema (non-production).
body: Create seed/fixture data for $ARGUMENTS. Match the real schema and constraints, use realistic but synthetic values (never real PII), and keep it idempotent. Confirm the target is a dev/test database before inserting.

name: inspect
description: Inspect images/containers: config, ports, mounts, health.
body: Inspect the Docker target in $ARGUMENTS using the `docker-fundamentals` skill. Detect docker first. Show config, ports, mounts, env (redact secrets), and health. Summarize anything risky (running as root, exposed ports, missing healthcheck).

name: build
description: Build an image and review the Dockerfile for size/security.
body: Build the image for $ARGUMENTS using the `docker-fundamentals`/`docker-image-optimization` skills. Review the Dockerfile for multi-stage, non-root user, layer caching and secret leakage before/while building. Report image size and improvement suggestions.

name: logs
description: Fetch and analyze container logs for errors.
body: Fetch logs for the container in $ARGUMENTS (`docker logs`) and analyze them using the `log-analysis` skill. Surface errors, restarts and their likely cause. Redact any secrets that appear in logs.

name: troubleshoot
description: Diagnose a failing/unhealthy container or build.
body: Troubleshoot the Docker problem in $ARGUMENTS using the `docker-ops` and `debugging` skills. Check logs, inspect config, exit codes and healthchecks. Identify the root cause (bad entrypoint, missing env, port conflict, OOM) and propose a fix.

name: cleanup
description: Report reclaimable Docker space and prune safely (with confirmation).
body: Report reclaimable Docker resources using `docker system df`. Propose what to prune (dangling images, stopped containers, unused volumes) and require explicit confirmation before running any prune. Never prune volumes with data without a clear warning.

name: compose
description: Bring up / inspect a Docker Compose stack and verify health.
body: Operate the Docker Compose stack per $ARGUMENTS using the `docker-compose` skill. Read the compose file, check healthchecks/dependencies, and run the requested action. For `down`, warn if it removes volumes with data. Report service health after `up`.

name: audit
description: Run a defensive security audit of the codebase.
body: Run a defensive security audit of $ARGUMENTS using the `security-audit` skill (and delegate to the `security-auditor` agent for depth). Cover secrets, vulnerable deps, injection sinks, authz gaps and misconfig. Prioritize findings by real exploitability and give concrete fixes. This is defensive review only.

name: secrets
description: Scan the repo and history for leaked credentials.
body: Scan $ARGUMENTS for leaked secrets using the `security-secrets` skill. Use gitleaks/trufflehog if available, plus targeted grep of code and git history. For any finding, advise rotating the secret (not just deleting it) and moving it to a secret manager. Redact the secret value in your report.

name: deps
description: Audit dependencies for known vulnerabilities.
body: Audit dependencies in $ARGUMENTS using the `security-dependencies` skill. Run the ecosystem's auditor (npm audit / pip-audit / osv-scanner). Triage high/critical CVEs, distinguish exploitable from noise, and suggest safe upgrade paths. Note transitive risk.

name: headers
description: Check a URL's HTTP security headers and suggest hardening.
body: Check security headers for the URL in $ARGUMENTS using the `security-headers` skill. Fetch headers (curl -sI) and report on CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, frame options and referrer policy. Suggest concrete hardening for anything missing/weak.

name: permissions
description: Review file/dir or IAM permissions for least-privilege issues.
body: Review permissions for $ARGUMENTS using the `security-iam`/`file-operations` skills. For files, flag world-writable or over-permissive modes and secrets readable by all. For IAM policies, flag wildcards and over-broad grants. Recommend least-privilege changes.

name: threat-model
description: Produce a lightweight STRIDE threat model for a feature.
body: Threat-model the feature in $ARGUMENTS using the `security-threat-modeling` skill. Identify assets, entry points and trust boundaries, enumerate STRIDE threats, and propose prioritized mitigations. Keep it practical and tied to this system.

name: search
description: Search file contents or names across the project.
body: Search for $ARGUMENTS using the `code-search` skill. Prefer ripgrep/structural search, scope by path/type, and present results as file:line with brief context. Distinguish real matches from comments/strings when it matters.

name: analyze
description: Detect a file's real type, encoding, size and metadata.
body: Analyze the file in $ARGUMENTS using the `file-operations` skill. Detect the real type by content (not just extension), report encoding, size, line count and relevant metadata, and note anything unusual (binary in a text path, wrong encoding, embedded secrets).

name: convert
description: Convert a file between formats losslessly.
body: Convert the file in $ARGUMENTS using the `data-format-conversion` skill. Pick the right tool for the format pair, preserve data/types and encoding, and verify the round-trip. Confirm before overwriting an existing target.

name: hash
description: Compute and/or verify a file's checksum.
body: Compute the SHA-256 of the file in $ARGUMENTS (certutil on Windows, sha256sum on POSIX). If an expected hash is given, compare and clearly state match/mismatch. Useful for integrity checks of downloads/artifacts.

name: dedupe
description: Find duplicate files by content hash (report only).
body: Find duplicate files under $ARGUMENTS by hashing contents. Group duplicates and report wasted space. Only report; never delete without explicit per-group confirmation from the user.

name: tree
description: Show an annotated project structure overview.
body: Show the directory structure of $ARGUMENTS (sensible default depth), ignoring node_modules/.git/build artifacts. Annotate the important directories and entry points so a newcomer can orient quickly.

name: bulk-rename
description: Preview and apply a bulk rename by pattern (with confirmation).
body: Plan a bulk rename per $ARGUMENTS using the `file-operations` and `safe-execution` skills. First show the full before -> after preview and check for collisions/overwrites. Only apply after explicit confirmation. Never overwrite an existing target silently.

name: inspect
description: Summarize OS, CPU, memory, disk and key runtimes.
body: Summarize the system using the `environment-detection` skill: OS/arch, CPU/memory, disk usage, and installed runtimes with versions. Present a concise capability snapshot. Probe, don't assume.

name: processes
description: Show top resource-consuming processes.
body: Show the top processes by CPU or memory (per $ARGUMENTS) using the `system-monitoring` skill (Get-Process on Windows, top/ps on POSIX). Identify likely resource hogs and note if anything looks abnormal.

name: disk
description: Report disk usage and find large files/directories.
body: Report disk usage for $ARGUMENTS using the `system-monitoring` skill. Show free/used per volume and the largest directories/files. Suggest safe cleanup candidates but never delete without confirmation.

name: network
description: Diagnose local connectivity, DNS and open ports.
body: Diagnose networking for $ARGUMENTS using the `networking-fundamentals` skill. Check connectivity (ping/traceroute), DNS (dig/nslookup), and listening ports (ss/netstat). Isolate whether an issue is DNS, connectivity or a firewall/port problem.

name: env
description: Show relevant environment variables (secrets redacted).
body: Show environment variables matching $ARGUMENTS (or the development-relevant ones) using the `environment-detection` skill. Always redact values that look like secrets (KEY/TOKEN/PASSWORD/SECRET/DSN). Explain which ones affect the current project.

name: run
description: Run a named or ad-hoc multi-step pipeline (analyze -> test -> build).
body: Run the pipeline described in $ARGUMENTS using the `pipelines` skill. Resolve the ordered steps, run them with clear per-step status, stop on a hard failure (surfacing which step failed and its log), and honor safe-execution confirmation for any destructive step. Report a final summary.

name: create
description: Define a reusable pipeline from a sequence of commands.
body: Define a reusable pipeline from $ARGUMENTS using the `pipelines` skill. Capture the ordered steps, their on-error behavior, retries and timeouts, and where they can run in parallel. Save it (e.g. under `.udt/pipelines/`) and show how to run it with /pipeline:run.

name: status
description: Show the status/logs of the most recent pipeline run.
body: Report the status of the last pipeline run using the `pipelines` skill: which steps passed/failed, timings, and the failing step's log if any. Read from the pipeline run records under `.udt/` if present.

name: detect
description: Detect language, framework, package manager and build system.
body: Detect the project stack for $ARGUMENTS using the `environment-detection` skill, from real manifest/lockfiles and config. Report language, framework, package manager, build system and test framework, plus which UDT skills apply. State detected vs. assumed.

name: onboard
description: Produce a newcomer onboarding overview of the project.
body: Onboard a newcomer to $ARGUMENTS using the `code-analysis` skill. Explain what the project does, its architecture and entry points, how to build/run/test it, and where the important code lives. Point out gotchas. Base everything on the real code, not guesses.

name: healthcheck
description: Assess project health: tests, lint, deps, docs, CI.
body: Assess the health of $ARGUMENTS. Check for: a passing test suite, lint/format config, dependency freshness/vulnerabilities, README/setup docs, and CI. Produce a scored summary with the highest-impact improvements first. Run checks where tools exist; don't fabricate results.

name: structure
description: Explain the project's architecture and module boundaries.
body: Explain the architecture of $ARGUMENTS using the `code-analysis` and `architecture-patterns` skills. Map modules, layers and their dependencies, identify the pattern in use, and flag boundary violations or tangled coupling.

name: inspect
description: Summarize cloud account resources for the detected provider (read-only).
body: Inspect cloud resources for the provider in $ARGUMENTS using the relevant `cloud-*` skill. Detect the CLI (aws/az/gcloud) and identity first. List key resources read-only. Redact account identifiers/secrets. Never create, modify or delete resources here.

name: cost
description: Identify likely cloud cost drivers and savings.
body: Analyze cloud costs for $ARGUMENTS using the `cloud-cost-optimization` skill. Identify idle/oversized resources, missing autoscaling, and expensive storage/egress patterns from available data. Suggest concrete, safe savings ranked by impact.

name: deploy
description: Review a deployment plan for safety before applying (no auto-apply).
body: Review the deployment for $ARGUMENTS using the `deployment-strategies` skill. Show the plan/diff (e.g. terraform plan, k8s diff) and check for a rollback path, backward-compatible migrations, and health checks. Do not apply automatically; require explicit confirmation to proceed.

name: generate
description: Generate a CI workflow tailored to the detected stack.
body: Generate a CI workflow for the detected stack using the `ci-cd-pipeline-design` skill. Include lint, test and build with caching and least-privilege tokens; pin third-party actions. Target the provider in $ARGUMENTS (default: GitHub Actions). Explain each stage.

name: lint
description: Validate a CI configuration file for correctness and safety.
body: Validate the CI config in $ARGUMENTS using the relevant CI skill. Lint the syntax, and review for security issues (untrusted-PR execution, secret exposure to forks, unpinned actions) and slow/uncached steps. Report fixes.

name: status
description: Summarize recent CI run results and failures.
body: Summarize recent CI status using `gh run list`/`glab ci status` if available. Report pass/fail of recent runs and, for failures, the failing job and likely cause from its log. Offer to help fix a specific failure.
